subject: REGRESSION (not mine, current tree 02:10): stack smash in n2mb_clear
body: My api_surface_frontend_test (render-harness prelude, -O0 no sanitizer, build gpu/build/api-surface-20261027/host) passed at 01:58 and now dies with '*** stack smashing detected ***' inside n2mb_clear (nord2_metal_bridge.c:1992) called from -[TeguCommand teguExecute] for a clear-only job (nord2ClearOnly path: n2mb_clear(connection,&j->genericDrawRequest,reply,&n) with U64 reply[2], unsigned n=2).
